BRANCH sram-smoke ONLY. docs/DECISIONS.md D-015 allows the macro keys below on this
branch; `main` keeps the untouched template config until the M2 memory decision.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
MACROS - the LibreLane way of bringing in a hard macro (NOT EXTRA_LEFS/EXTRA_GDS_FILES).
https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/usage/using_macros.html . Key = the macro name,
not the instance. Everything below is vendored at IHP-Open-PDK commit 2bbec755; see
macro/RM_IHPSG13_1P_512x16_c2_bm_bist/README.md.
instances.u_imem.sram.orientation - FS, i.e. mirrored about the X axis (LEF SYMMETRY X Y
R90 allows it). All 108 signal pins of the macro are Metal2
stubs at LEF y 0..0.26, its bottom edge. Unmirrored (N) at
(12, 10) that edge sat 6 um above the core edge and CI run 4
drowned in detailed routing (3013 violations at iteration 0,
about 2600 after 50). FS puts the pins on the TOP edge, facing
the free rows and the block's own pins (y 313.24 in
tt_block_2x2_pgvdd.def). Mirroring about X keeps every power
column at the same x, so the stripe alignment below is unchanged.
Orientation must keep the columns vertical (N, FS, FN or S): the
stripes are Metal4 like the pins, so they cannot cross them.
instances.u_imem.sram.location - lower-left corner of the placed macro, absolute in the
DIE_AREA from tile_sizes.yaml. 2x2: die 419.52 x 313.74, rows
within FP_MACRO_*_HALO = 10 um of the macro are cut. The macro
WHY y = 40: the macro's supplies can only be reached at the edge
each Metal4 column touches (see src/pdn_cfg.tcl). VDD! columns
touch only the pin edge (top in FS), VDDARRAY! only the other
one (bottom in FS), VSS! both. So stripes must arrive from
below as well as above. Below: y 3.78..30 keeps 6 rows (ROW_0 to
ROW_5, tops at 26.46), whose rails tie the stripe stubs
(y 3.56..39.5) into the grid before they are bridged into
VDDARRAY!. At y = 10 there were no rows under the macro, pdngen
trimmed the stubs, and VDDARRAY! would have no connection.
Above: 78.6 um to the core top, rows from y 241.34 (18 rows),
plus the free 10 um band over the pins for their escape routes.
Right of the macro: x 258.8..416.64 of rows at full height.
x = 12 is what makes FP_PDN_VOFFSET land the stripes inside the
macro's power columns; change one, recompute the other.
nl - the port-only blackbox in src/, not the behavioural model. Same as the reference.
PDN_MACRO_CONNECTIONS - hooks the macro's power pins onto the block's nets without needing
USE_POWER_PINS in the RTL. Format: <instance> <block power net> <block ground net>
<macro power pin> <macro ground pin>. The macro has three: VDD! (periphery), VDDARRAY!
(the bit-cell array) and VSS!. Both supplies go to VPWR, as the reference project does;
the macro would allow them to be separate rails but Tiny Tapeout only gives us one.
PDN_CFG - LibreLane's default PDN script with its macro grid replaced. On cmos5l
FP_PDN_VERTICAL_LAYER is Metal4, which is also the layer of the macro's power pins, and
TopMetal1 belongs to tt_top, so the default macro grid (Metal4 <-> TopMetal1) is empty
(PDN-0232, CI runs 2-3) and pdngen alone leaves the macro unconnected (CI run 4). The
script adds short Metal4 bridges from the aligned stripe ends into the macro's pin columns
and fails the PDN step at once if check_power_grid still finds an open.
DRT_OPT_ITERS - SMOKE-TEST BOUND, not for a real submission. TritonRoute stops after 12
optimisation iterations instead of 64, so a run that cannot route ends within the hour
with its GDS_logs artifact (CI run 4 was killed by the 6-hour job limit and uploaded
nothing).
SRAM GDS has no PR boundary layer; read the full GDS instead of a blackbox.
(cmos5l sets PRIMARY_GDSII_STREAMOUT_TOOL=klayout, so this may end up unused; kept because
it is harmless and it is what the reference needs.)
SRAM macro internals trigger massive DRC in Magic; skip (KLayout DRC is already off below).
Blackbox the SRAM macro during SPICE extraction for LVS: the IHP macros are not LVS clean.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html

Absolute die size
PDN geometry. Only VPITCH/VSPACING/VOFFSET differ from the template, and only so that the
Metal4 stripes sit inside the macro's Metal4 power pins. VWIDTH stays at the template's 2.1
because these stripes are also the block's power pins, which tt_top connects to.
VPITCH   67.44 = 6 x 11.24 um, the macro's same-net power column pitch, chosen so that no
stripe lands in the macro's irregular middle band.
VSPACING 3.52: OpenROAD puts the GROUND stripe of a pair at (spacing + width) = 5.62 um
from the POWER stripe centre, which is the macro's POWER-to-GROUND column
distance.
VOFFSET  26.36 measured from the core-area xMin of 2.88, giving the first POWER stripe
centre at 29.24 = macro x 12 + 17.24.
Full derivation and the verified stripe positions are in src/pdn_cfg.tcl.
